Hi Sarah — great to hear from you. Yes, we can provide a signed invitation letter on Redwood letterhead that includes participant names, travel dates, a short one-paragraph agenda, and the hosting logistics (venue + point of contact).

Turnaround: I can get a draft to you today and the signed PDF by end of day tomorrow (Aug 6) if that works for your booking windows. We’ll attach the PDF here and upload to the shared Drive.

Regarding passports: Redwood travel policy mirrors the common consulate rule — passports should be valid at least six months after the trip end-date. Marco’s passport expiring March 2027 is over six months past Sep 2026 cutoff, so he should be fine for Zurich. If anyone on your side has less than six months remaining we recommend renewing ASAP and using the expedited courier.

What I need from you to finalize the invitation: full legal names as on passport, passport nationality, passport numbers (or we can omit numbers and include only names if your legal team prefers), and preferred mailing address for any physical documents. Also tell us if you require a separate attendee letter for each person or a single group letter.

I’m copying Priya from travel ops who will coordinate express courier if you need physical originals.

Thanks — I’ll drop the draft in the drive and send the signed PDF once Priya OKs the format.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
